recipes.name: HEALTHY MEALS: BROWN RICE
ingredients: 1 cup dried brown rice, short grain
1 cup mushrooms of choice (we used cremini and enoki), washed and sliced
1 small onion or 1/2 large onion, finely chopped
freshly ground black pepper, to taste
1 cup dry brown rice, or as needed
1 tsp Thai chili powder, or to taste
10 mint leaves, torn, or to taste
4 1/2 large lettuce leaves (we used butter lettuce), to garnish
1 cup leftover chicken, shredded (poached, rotisserie, grilled, etc.)
To taste freshly ground black pepper
instructions: For Stovetop Rice:
In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil. - 2 ¼ cups water

Add the rice, cover with a lid and cook for 25 minutes, or until all the water is absorbed. *If there is still some water left, let the rice cook for another 2-3 minutes. - 1 cup dried brown rice basmati
Turn off the heat and wrap the lid in a dish towel and replace it on the pot. Let sit for 5 minutes.
Season and serve as desired. - ½ tsp fresh thyme - 1 tbsp olive oil - ½ lime juiced - 2 tbsp parsley - salt to taste - pepper to taste
For Oven-Baked Rice:
In a small Dutch oven, bring water to a boil on the stovetop. - 2 ½ cups water
Add the rice, and cover with a lid. Place the pot in a 375°F oven and cook for 35 minutes. - 1 cup dried brown rice short grain
Remove the pot from the oven and let sit for 5 minutes, covered.
Season and serve as desired. - salt to taste - pepper to taste
For Seared Chicken:
Slice the chicken breast in half lengthwise. - 2 chicken breasts

Combine garlic, olive oil, oregano, smoked paprika, lime juice, salt, and pepper in a medium-size bowl. Stir to combine. - 2 garlic cloves crushed - 3 tbsp olive oil divided - ½ tsp oregano - ¼ tsp smoked paprika - 1 lime juiced - 1 tsp kosher salt - 1 tsp freshly ground black pepper
Add the chicken breasts and combine with your hands. - 2 chicken breasts
Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes or up to 2 hours. - 2 chicken breasts
Preheat a large skillet with olive oil. - 3 tbsp olive oil divided
Pan sear the chicken, cooking on both sides for about 4-6 minutes. The internal temperature of the chicken should reach 165°F when cooked through. - 2 chicken breasts
Allow to cool completely before portioning and storing.
For Sesame Broccoli:
Combine olive and sesame oil, whisk to combine. - 2 tsp olive oil - 1 ½ tsp sesame oil
Toss broccoli with both oils, salt, and pepper on a small rimmed baking sheet. - 2 cups broccoli florets - 2 tsp olive oil - 1 ½ tsp sesame oil - ½ tsp kosher salt - ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper
Roast at 400°F for 10 minutes, then rotate the pan for even browning. Continue cooking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the broccoli is crispy.
Remove the broccoli from the oven and sprinkle with sesame seeds. - 2 tsp white sesame seeds
Allow cooling before portioning and storing.
For the Assembly
In your choice of Tupperware, portion the chicken breasts, broccoli, and brown rice.
Store in the refrigerator for up to 7 days.
For Fried Rice:

Add oil to a large high-sided skillet or wok and heat over high heat. Sauté the mushrooms until they are browned and crispy, and reserve in a separate bowl. - vegetable oil as needed - 1 cup mushrooms of choice (we used cremini and enoki) washed and sliced

Add more oil to the pan and add the onion and carrots to the pan. Cook for 30 seconds, or until slightly tender, then add the garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant, about 10 seconds. - vegetable oil as needed - 1 small onion or 1/2 large onion finely chopped - 1 carrot finely chopped - 1 clove garlic minced - 1 ½ tsp freshly grated ginger
Push the vegetables to the outer sides of the pan, add oil to the center of the pan and add the rice. Flatten the rice into an even disk. - vegetable oil as needed - 2 cup leftover brown rice
Drizzle the sesame oil along the outside rim of the pan and allow the rice to crisp undisturbed for 1 minute. - 2 tsp sesame oil

Add the soy sauce, mirin, rice vinegar, peas, and reserved mushrooms. Stir and/or toss everything to combine in the pan. - 1 tbsp soy sauce preferably dark - 1 ½ tsp mirin - 1 tbsp rice vinegar - ½ cup frozen peas - 1 cup mushrooms of choice (we used cremini and enoki) washed and sliced

Once again, push the rice and vegetables to the outer sides of the pan, add oil to the center of the pan and add the egg. Using chopsticks or a fork, scramble the egg until it is cooked completely, then toss/stir to combine with the other ingredients. - vegetable oil as needed - 1 large egg

Season the rice to taste with salt and pepper, then garnish with green onions and optionally, spicy chili crisp. - kosher salt to taste - freshly ground black pepper to taste - 1 green onion (greens only) finely sliced - spicy chili crisp optional
For Larb:
For the Lettuce Wraps & Mango Sticky Rice inspired by Spider-Man: Homecoming:

In a medium skillet, add the dry brown rice and dry toast for 15-20 minutes over medium-low heat. Make sure to stir the pan periodically to avoid uneven browning. Once browned, allow to cool completely. - 1 cup dry brown rice or as needed
Add the toasted rice to a food processor or high-powdered spice grinder, blend until the rice reaches a coarse-sand consistency. - 1 cup dry brown rice or as needed

In a large skillet, add the vegetable oil. Heat over medium-high heat and then add the pork. Using a fat sided spatula, break up any large pieces of pork and continue cooking until the pork is browned. - 1 ½ tbsp vegetable oil - 1 lb ground pork

Add the remaining ingredients and stir to combine. - 1 tsp lemongrass grated - 1 tsp Thai chili powder or to taste - ½ tsp brown sugar packed - ½ tbsp fish sauce - 2 limes juiced, or to taste - 1 shallot finely chopped - 3 scallion finely sliced - 10 mint leaves torn, or to taste - 1 tbsp cilantro chopped - 1 cup cooked brown rice
Spoon the larb mixture into the large lettuce leaf cups and serve. - 4 ½ large lettuce leaves (we used butter lettuce) to garnish
For Avgolemono:
Heat the stock in a medium pot or high-sided skillet. - 4 cups chicken stock
In a separate small bowl, whisk the eggs until frothy. - 2 eggs
While whisking, stream the lemon juice into the eggs. - ⅓ cup lemon juice
Slowly add small amounts of warm stock to the egg mixture. One half of the stock has been incorporated, set the mixture aside. - 4 cups chicken stock

Meanwhile, add the chicken and rice to the chicken sauce. Cook for 3-5 minutes until the chicken is warmed through. - 1 cup leftover chicken shredded (poached, rotisserie, grilled, etc.) - 1 cup leftover brown rice
Add the tempered egg mixture and cook on medium-low heat for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the soup no longer froths when whisked. Make sure to stir constantly to avoid scrambling the eggs.
Serve immediately.
